rows_considered_not_moved.PLAY-01: NOT MOVED (kept UNVERIFIED). PLAY-01's definition is a full playback-control matrix ('Watch, seek, quality, speed, resume, PiP/theater and mobile/native playback ... Chromium plus native-HLS Safari on representative ladder'). This iOS pass is a single-device smoke of page-load + currentTime advance (0 -> 2.255 s) + sign-in on one rendition; it exercises no seek/quality/speed/resume/PiP and no representative ladder, and it took the Managed Media Source (blob:) path, NOT the native-HLS branch PLAY-01's Safari slice (docs/evidence/play-01-safari.json) established. In the native-runtime v0.6.6 disposition PLAY-01 is UNVERIFIED pending full re-execution on the v0.6.6 digests; a single-device subset does not satisfy that. The pass is recorded as a measured subset instead.
rows_considered_not_moved.QLT-02: NOT MOVED (kept UNVERIFIED). QLT-02's definition is a full control + accessibility inventory ('All required screens handle keyboard/mobile/themes/errors and real persistence' — inventory every required control by role; 390px and desktop; light/dark; keyboard/axe; loading/empty/error/retry; mutation readback after full reload). This iOS pass drives no control inventory, no axe/keyboard, no theme or error-state checks. It does use a real touch device (a residual QLT-02 flagged as missing), but that is one fragment of a large row. Recorded as a measured subset instead.
rows_considered_not_moved.basis: Be conservative: a single device + version sample does not close a full browser matrix. No UNVERIFIED->PASS move is made; counts are unchanged at 5/45/9.
